name: get_stats
description: Token-cheap document census for a session: words, paragraphs, tables, callouts, images, and an estimated editorial page budget (layout-weighted by words, tables, images, and explicit page breaks) in a single small envelope. Counters are the exact engine counters behind CLI stats, so both surfaces always agree. Physical pagination is finalized when exporting to PDF via LibreOffice. Read-only: never mutates, never bumps the revision. Returns {ok:true,sessionId,revision,dirty,words,paragraphs,tables,callouts,images,pages,pageTerms}. pages is a rough estimate, max(1, ceil(words/450 + 0.45 per table or callout + 0.5 per image + 1 per page break)); pageTerms gives those four terms in pages, so a caller can see how much of it is counted from tables, callouts, images and page breaks (`pageTerms.tables` covers tables and callouts), which the estimate cannot size. Use visual_inspect for the renderer's page count. A callout (a "> [!NOTE]" alert or a callout op: a one-cell table with a fill) is counted in callouts and not in tables. Use instead of inspect_document when only counts are needed (a full TOON dump costs thousands of tokens for the same question). Example {"sessionId":"sess_abc"} -> {"ok":true,"words":42,"paragraphs":5}.
